verses.pali: “Saṁyojaniyesu, bhikkhave, dhammesu assādānupassino viharato viññāṇassa avakkanti hoti.
verses.english: “There are things that tighten the fetters. When you concentrate on the gratification provided by these things, consciousness is conceived.
Consciousness is a requirement for name and form. …
That is how this entire mass of suffering originates.
Suppose there was a great tree.
And its roots going downwards and across all draw the sap upwards. …

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, saṁyojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato viññāṇassa avakkanti hoti …pe….
verses.english: In the same way, there are things that tighten the fetters. When you concentrate on the gratification provided by these things, consciousness is conceived. …

verses.pali: Saṁyojaniyesu, bhikkhave, dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato viññāṇassa avakkanti na hoti.
verses.english: There are things that tighten the fetters. When you concentrate on the drawbacks of these things, consciousness is not conceived.
When consciousness ceases, name and form cease. …
That is how this entire mass of suffering ceases.
Suppose there was a great tree.
Then a person comes along with a spade and basket. …
In this way the great tree is cut off at the root, made like a palm stump, obliterated, and unable to arise in the future.

verses.pali: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, saṁyojaniyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato viññāṇassa avakkanti na hoti.
verses.english: In the same way, there are things that tighten the fetters. When you concentrate on the drawbacks of these things, consciousness is not conceived.
When consciousness ceases, name and form cease. …
That is how this entire mass of suffering ceases.”
